title: Page 2
lines: 为什么自己会知情呢？
原因无他，因为赵若瑜面对“新生”很兴奋，把同个娘胎出来的双生姊姊当成一般孩童，有些事她不能告诉别人，便对着她这个姊姊说个没完，偶尔还忘我的说两句日语。
真不是她要嫌弃，但她这个妹妹真是近乎智障，赵若瑾真的很无言，妹妹说得越多她越沉默，最后干脆装睡，睡着睡着就真的睡着了。
同样是穿越人士，表现出来的模样却大不相同。
赵若瑜很积极，积极着长大，好颠覆这个世界，她以为她是唯一的主角，正朝妖魔化演变。
别人六个月大还在学翻身，她已经能坐得稳当，笑得咯咯咯地鼓掌拍手，九个月就蹒跚走起路，十个月再大一点还不到十一个月大便会开口喊爹娘，虽然发音还不是很标准。
越长越大也越来越往神童发展，一岁能念诗，三岁能作诗，五岁不到成了别人口中的小才女，名声之响亮到无人不知、无人不晓的地步，她常洋洋得意的自我炫耀。
反之，嫡长女赵若瑾就是一个“正常”的孩子，七个月大才会坐，一岁两个月时要人家牵着慢慢学步，一岁半才张口喊爹娘，之后便是吃喝玩乐，尽情地当个孩子。
赵若瑾开始写诗时她才学会握笔，一笔一捺地练习“永”字，五岁大时接触第一本书——《千字文》，由简而难地启蒙。
如今赵若瑾七岁了，她还是反应比妹妹慢一步的大小姐，除了爱看书、喜爱习字外，她的日子过得枯燥乏味，宛若一泓静止的水，默默的隐于妹妹的光彩之后，不与其争辉。
没人晓得她的上一世是金融系大学讲师，靠着对数字的敏锐赚足上亿身家，开名车、住豪宅、品尝昂贵的红酒，三十七岁的她高挑貌美，拥有模特儿身材，还有小她十岁的助教男友，不婚不生子，过着半同居的美好日子。
【本段不纯洁的描写已删减，万分抱歉】
之后她才知晓原来她是在娘胎里，包围着她的是羊水，因为有两个人，所以空间有点窄，她没法翻身或做其他事，每日就被脾气不好的另一个人挤来挤去，有时还对她拳打脚踢。
好在这样的日子没过多久，大概过了两个月她就出生了，一滑出产道，她高兴的手舞足蹈，终于能伸展手脚了，她大概是唯一没有哭，笑着出世的孩子，把接生的稳婆吓了一跳。
因此她的小名叫乐姊儿。
而晚她两刻钟生出来的妹妹却哭声震天，她哭是因为自己不是第一个出生的孩子——在娘胎里时，她们已能听见外界的声音，知晓这个世界讲究嫡庶之分，嫡长和嫡次虽只差一个字，将来议亲是有很大的差别，尽管容貌相似，但高门娶媳通常以嫡长为主。
也就是说长媳要娶嫡长，而次子或幼子才娶嫡次，一个“长”字占全了所有好处，长子长媳掌家，是为家主。
“不能，小姐，你有个叫笑姊儿的妹妹。”她不是独生女，上有一兄，下有一弟一妹。
笑姊儿，很讽刺的小名，当初因为赵若瑜哭个不停才取个“笑”字逗她开怀大笑，没想到她压根不喜欢，谁叫她笑姊儿她就瞪人，逼人家只能喊她二小姐或瑜儿。
赵若瑾很悲摧的拉下锦被，一张面白如玉的小脸露了出来。“温香，你坏，就不能骗骗我吗？”
她努力装个小孩子，到目前为止还算成功。
温香笑了笑，将拧干的巾子往主子娇贵的脸皮上轻擦。“是，奴婢坏，奴婢给小姐换下寝衣。”
“我还没刷牙。”嘴臭。
取了青盐来的温香为她净牙，她手指头细长，动作很熟练，等她牙口干净了，又端来薄荷水让她漱口。
“小姐，你还没好吗？我看到二小姐到夫人屋里请安了。”匆匆来到的软玉换了一套衣服，是掐花蓝布衣裙。
正在梳发的赵若瑾一听，两道细细的月牙眉微微一颦。“软玉，你好吵，没看见我正在梳头发吗？”
她早晚各梳一次头，每回由上而下的梳一百五十下，当她的双胞胎妹妹上跳下蹿的求发光发亮的机会时，她很低调、很隐密的调理自己的身子，从头到脚，由里而外，人有健康的身体才是保固，日后“逃命”也方便，没有强健的腿骨哪跑得过敌人？
所谓天有不测风云，人有旦夕祸福，谁知道哪一天会发生什么事，未雨绸缪才能有备无患，越是高位越容易遭殃，她爹和二叔父在朝廷上也有三、五个仇人，难保哪一个不会突然抽风了干了蠢事，五代袭爵的勋贵也有一朝湮灭的可能。
就算没有那些起起伏伏，也要把自个儿的身子养好，在这个缺医少药，医学不发达的年代，一个小小的风寒就能要人命，所以她更要小心保重，强身健体，把底子打好。
且爱美是人的天性，还不到化妆年龄的她从头发保养做起，每天按摩头皮几百下，长出的发丝油油发亮，彷佛是黑色的丝绸一般，柔亮滑手，黑如鸦羽，光可监人。
经过几年的条理，她越发让自己和双胞妹妹不像，虽然五官上仍相似得如同一个样子，但气质上已经有了显着的不同，让人一眼就能认出谁是姊姊，谁是妹妹，不再搞混。
很不容易呀！姊妹面容相同却气质相异。
一回想起一岁以前的情景，那简直是叫人半夜惊醒的恶趣味，她的爹娘一得到双生女儿太高兴了，鞋子、衣服、饰品等全是双份，两个女儿打扮得一模一样，如出一辙。
她是认命了，由他们恶搞，因为“小孩子不懂得反抗”，她任人摆布，当作是女儿的孝心。
可赵若瑜不喜欢和别人一样，她要当唯一，她要与众不同，因此又哭又闹的不做和姊姊相似的装扮，这场恶梦方才结束。
“小姐，你要是去晚了，夫人又要唠叨上老半天，你到时可别喊耳朵痛，叫奴婢给你揉耳朵。”软玉很无辜的说着实话，小姐最怕人念了，夫人一念她就走神得厉害，昏昏欲睡频点头，夫人恨铁不成钢的气得快冒火。
是呀！她那个娘实在太闲了，闲得只能动舌头。“好了、好了，用那条下头有铃铛的紫红色丝绳系发就好，
妹妹都去了，咱们得赶紧走。唉！我明明还是小孩子，请什么安。”不让小孩子睡饱是虐童。
前一世除了当大学讲师，又要忙着理财，钱是够用了，可是她老嚷着时间不够用，想去短期旅游都抽不出空，十分羡慕那些说走就走的背包客，一只背包走遍天下。
可是等她穿越来到这个史书上没有的大楚朝，她才真的想哭，上辈子是忙得足不沾地，似乎永远有忙不完的事情，而当了侯府千金以后，她是闲得快发慌，整日无所事事的只能发呆。
所以，其实高智商的赵若瑾在所有人眼中就是呆呆傻傻的样子，她没法真的装小和她同年纪的孩子一起玩耍，一是孩童的游戏对她而言太无聊，再者层次不同，沟通上困难，索性就大眼瞪小眼，装傻蒙混过去就算了。
久而久之，人家就真的把她当傻子看待，“交游广阔”的赵若瑜有一群谈得来的好姊妹，不时花蝴蝶似的应邀到各个府上作客，偶遇了姊妹们的兄弟，认识不少将来的青年才俊——现在大家都还小，要有成就须等八年后。
content_en:
Why do you know this?
There is no other reason for this, because Zhao Ruoyu is very excited about the "new life" and treats the twin sisters who were born from the same mother as ordinary children. There are some things that she cannot tell others, so she talks endlessly to her sister, and occasionally even forgets to say a few words in Japanese.
She really didn't want to dislike her, but her sister was really almost mentally retarded. Zhao Ruojin was really speechless. The more her sister talked, the more silent she became. In the end, she just pretended to be asleep, and fell asleep when she fell asleep.
They are also time-travelers, but their appearance is completely different.
Zhao Ruoyu is very active and wants to grow up so that she can subvert the world. She thinks that she is the only protagonist and is evolving towards demonization.
While others are still learning to roll over at six months old, she can already sit firmly, giggle and clap her hands, and starts to stagger around at nine months old. At ten months old, she will start calling her father and mother before she is even eleven months old, although her pronunciation is not very standard yet.
As she grew older, she became more and more like a child prodigy. She could read poetry at the age of one and compose poetry at the age of three. She became what others call a talented girl by the age of five. Her reputation was so great that no one knew about it. She often showed off herself proudly.
On the other hand, Zhao Ruojin, the eldest daughter, is a "normal" child. She can't sit until she is seven months old. When she is one year and two months old, she needs to be held by others to slowly learn to walk. She doesn't open her mouth to call her daddy until she is one and a half years old. After that, she eats, drinks, plays, and lives like a child to her heart's content.
Zhao Ruojin only learned to hold a pen when she started writing poems, and practiced the word "Yong" one stroke at a time. When she was five years old, she came into contact with her first book - "The Thousand Character Essay", and she was enlightened through simplicity and difficulty.
Now that Zhao Ruojin is seven years old, she is still the eldest lady whose reaction is one step slower than her younger sister. Apart from her love of reading and practicing calligraphy, her life is boring and boring. She is like a still water, silently hiding behind the brilliance of her younger sister, not competing with her.
No one knows that in her previous life, she was a university lecturer in the Department of Finance. She earned hundreds of millions of dollars by relying on her keenness in numbers. She drove a luxury car, lived in a luxury house, and tasted expensive red wine. At the age of thirty-seven, she was tall and beautiful, with a model figure. She had a teaching assistant boyfriend who was ten years younger than her. She never married or had children, and they lived a good life semi-living together.
[The impure description in this paragraph has been deleted, I am extremely sorry]
Later she found out that she was in her mother's womb, surrounded by amniotic fluid. Because there were two people, the space was a little narrow. She couldn't turn over or do other things. She was squeezed here and there every day by another person with a bad temper, and sometimes he was punched and kicked.
Fortunately, such days did not last long, and she was born about two months later. As soon as she slipped out of the birth canal, she danced for joy and could finally stretch her arms and legs. She was probably the only child who was born without crying and smiling, which shocked the woman who delivered the baby.
Therefore, her nickname was Le Sister.
But her younger sister, who was born two-quarters of an hour after her, was crying loudly. She was crying because she was not the first child born. When they were in their mother's womb, they could already hear the voices of the outside world and knew that the world pays attention to the distinction between eldest son and concubine.
That is to say, the eldest daughter-in-law must marry the eldest son, and the second son or youngest son must marry the eldest son. The word "eldest" takes up all the benefits. The eldest son and the eldest daughter-in-law are in charge of the family and are the head of the family.
"No, miss, you have a sister named Xiao Jier." She is not an only child, she has an older brother, a younger brother and a younger sister.
Xiao Jie'er is a very ironic nickname. I gave Zhao Ruoyu the word "laugh" because she kept crying to make her laugh. Unexpectedly, she didn't like it at all. She would glare at anyone who called her Xiao Jie'er, forcing others to call her Second Miss or Yu'er.
Zhao Ruojin pulled down the brocade quilt sadly, revealing a small face as white as jade. "Wen Xiang, you are bad, can't you lie to me?"
She's trying to act like a kid, and so far she's been successful.
Wen Xiang smiled and gently wiped the wrung-out towel on her master's delicate face. "Yes, my servant is bad. Please change your pajamas for the young lady."
"I haven't brushed my teeth yet." My mouth smells bad.
He used the warm fragrance of green salt to clean her teeth. Her fingers were slender and her movements were very skillful. When her teeth were clean, he brought her mint water to rinse her mouth.
"Miss, are you okay yet? I saw the second young lady went to the madam's room to say hello." Nephrite came in a hurry and changed into a dress of blue cloth with floral patterns.
Zhao Ruojin, who was combing her hair, frowned slightly when she heard this. "Nephrite, you are so noisy, didn't you see that I was combing my hair?"
She combed her hair once in the morning and evening, 150 strokes from top to bottom each time. While her twin sisters were jumping up and down looking for a chance to shine, she was very low-key and very secretive in conditioning her body, from head to toe, from the inside out. A healthy body is the only guarantee for a person's health, and it will be easier to "escape" in the future. Without strong leg bones, how can one outrun the enemy?
As the saying goes, there are unpredictable events in the sky, and misfortunes and misfortunes happen to people. Who knows what will happen one day, so only by planning ahead can you be prepared. The higher you are, the more likely you are to suffer disaster. Her father and her second uncle also have three or five enemies in the court. It is hard to guarantee that one of them will not suddenly go crazy and do something stupid. The nobles who have inherited the title from the fifth generation may also be annihilated in one day.
Even if there are no ups and downs, she still has to take good care of her body. In this era of lack of medical treatment and underdeveloped medicine, a small cold can kill people, so she must take care of herself even more, keep fit, and lay a good foundation.
And it is human nature to love beauty. She is not yet old enough to put on makeup, but she started with hair care. She massages her scalp hundreds of times a day. The hair that grows out is shiny and shiny, like black silk. It is soft and smooth, black as crow feathers, and the light can catch people's attention.
After several years of practice, she has become more and more different from her twin sister. Although her facial features are still similar, her temperament has been significantly different. People can recognize who is the sister and who is the sister at a glance, and there is no longer confusion.
It’s not easy! The sisters have the same face but different temperaments.
Recalling the scene before she was one year old, it was a bad taste that would wake people up in the middle of the night. Her parents were so happy when they got twin daughters. They had duplicate shoes, clothes, accessories, etc. The two daughters were dressed exactly the same.
She accepted her fate and let them prank her, because "children don't know how to resist", she allowed herself to be manipulated as a sign of filial piety as a daughter.
But Zhao Ruoyu didn't like to be like others, she wanted to be the only one, she wanted to be different, so she cried and made a fuss and refused to dress up like her sister. This nightmare ended just now.
"Miss, if you arrive late, Madam will nag you for a long time. Don't complain that your ears hurt, and ask the slave to rub your ears." Ruanyu said the truth innocently. The young lady was most afraid of being read. When the madam thought about her, she became very distracted and nodded frequently, feeling drowsy. The madam was so angry that she hated the iron.
yes! Her mother is so idle that she can only move her tongue. "Okay, okay, just tie your hair with the purple silk rope with the bell at the bottom.
My sisters are all gone, we have to leave quickly. Alas! I'm obviously still a child, so what are you asking for? “Depriving children of adequate sleep is child abuse.
In her previous life, in addition to being a university lecturer, she was also busy with financial management. She had enough money, but she kept complaining that she didn't have enough time and couldn't spare the time even if she wanted to go on a short trip. She was very envious of those backpackers who could just go and travel around the world with just one backpack.
But she really wanted to cry when she traveled through time and came to the Chu Dynasty, which was not in the history books. In her previous life, she was so busy that she always seemed to have endless things to do. But after becoming the daughter of the Hou family, she was so idle that she could only be in a daze with nothing to do all day long.
Therefore, in fact, Zhao Ruojin, who has a high IQ, looks dull and stupid in everyone's eyes. She can't really pretend to be young and play with children of the same age. First, children's games are too boring for her. Furthermore, the levels are different and communication is difficult. She just stares at them and pretends to be stupid.
Over time, people really treated her as a fool. Zhao Ruoyu, who had "wide connections", had a group of good sisters with whom she got along well. From time to time, she was invited to various houses like butterflies. She met the brothers of the sisters by chance and got to know many young talents in the future - everyone is still young now, and they have to wait eight years for success.
